newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel threatens steps against strikers.
newsitem.headline: Israel threatens steps against strikers.

text.p: Israeli Finance Minister Dan Meridor threatened on Sunday to take steps to battle a wave of strikes that spread across the economy.

"I hope (the unions) will take the correct steps to avoid disrupting normal life. If they do not do this, we will take whatever actions are appropriate to enable the normal functions of society," he told a news conference without elaborating.
The country's Histadrut trade union federation launched the strikes last week in protest against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's 1997 budget proposal, which it said hurt the poor.
It accelerated the strikes on Sunday after police arrested the head of its trade union section for failing to appear in Tel Aviv labour court in connection with the strikes last week.
